extensionDescription.message: Search for torrents and send confirmed selections to WildBuzzard's native download manager.

invalidSearch.message: Enter a search of 1 to 256 characters.

confirmationDescription.message: This will add the selected torrent to WildBuzzard's native download manager.

importCancelled.message: Download cancelled. The torrent was not added.

importSucceeded.message: The torrent was added to the native download manager.

error_CLI_NOT_INSTALLED.message: Run sudo apt install buzzard-minijtt, then try again.

error_CLI_TIMEOUT.message: The search service took too long to respond.

error_CLI_PROTOCOL_ERROR.message: The search service returned an unsupported response.

error_TOKEN_EXPIRED.message: This result expired. Search again before downloading.

error_TOKEN_CONSUMED.message: This download confirmation was already used.

error_RESULT_NOT_FOUND.message: The selected result is no longer available.

error_TORRENT_INVALID.message: The selected source did not return valid torrent data.

error_IMPORT_FAILED.message: WildBuzzard could not add this torrent.

error_NOT_AUTHORIZED.message: This extension is not authorized to use torrent search.

error_BUSY.message: Too many searches are active. Wait and try again.

error_UNKNOWN.message: Torrent Search encountered an unexpected error.
